subject: Admin activity evidence: fine-grained visibility slices & ad-hoc export SLA
messages:
From: Alex Russo <alex.russo@healthgrid.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@healthgrid.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: scoped admin activity extracts for SIG questionnaire

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the vendor SIG review yesterday. Our security folks asked for an example of admin activity export that demonstrates:
- per-actor action list (create / delete / privilege-change) with object IDs,
- timezone-preserved timestamps,
- retention markers and TTL metadata, and
- the ability to slice by tenant and by resource class (models, keys, routes).

Can you provide a sample extract and a short note describing the export SLA for on-demand requests (expected turnaround for <30 day slices, and for historical 90-day snapshots)? Also flag anything that would require a legal/data request (PII redaction or signed DPA amendment).

Attaching HealthGrid SIG checklist excerpt for reference.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — auditor kickoff is 06/02.

Best,
Alex
Security Engineer | HealthGrid

---
Attachment: healthgrid-sig-excerpt.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Russo <alex.russo@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: scoped admin activity extracts for SIG questionnaire

Alex —

Thanks for the details and the checklist. Looping in Ben (Compliance eng) and Kim (Customer ops) to scope the extract and turnaround. High level answers up front:
- We can generate tenant-scoped admin activity slices with per-action rows (actor, verb, target_id, ip, timestamp, request_id, kv-delta) preserving original timezone.
- Default retention is 365 days for admin events; exports can include a TTL column where events older than retention are flagged.
- Small, ad-hoc <30 day slices: typical turnaround 48 hours.
- Historical 90-day snapshots that require manifest signing and HMAC attestations usually take 4-7 business days (depends on sampling/redaction).
- PII: exports can be produced as-is for account-scoped artifacts. If the request includes customer PII (end-user email in event payloads) we either pseudonymize or require a signed Data Access Addendum.

Action items:
1) Ben: can you confirm export formats (CSV vs compressed Parquet) and the default schema we’ll send?
2) Kim: I’ve included a draft export playbook (attached). Can you check delivery channels (S3 presigned vs SFTP vs secure Drive) and SLA alignment with Finance/legal?

I’ll draft a short cover note for HealthGrid’s auditor describing the fields and provenance guarantees.

Thanks —
Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: export-playbook-draft.pdf (pdf, 540KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Alex Russo <alex.russo@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: scoped admin activity extracts for SIG questionnaire

Alex / Monica —

Summary of export options and schema (quick):
Formats:
- CSV (human readable, column-delimited) — good for small slices and quick review.
- Parquet (compressed, columnar) — preferred for large historical exports and forensic tooling.

Core schema columns we include by default:
- event_id, timestamp_utc, timezone_offset, actor_id, actor_email, actor_role, action, target_type, target_id, request_id, ip_address, user_agent, kv_before, kv_after, retention_flag, export_manifest_id

Redaction & Pseudonymization:
- We can pseudonymize actor_email and target metadata on request (deterministic hash with salt so cross-slice linkage remains possible).
- If you request PII-free outputs, we’ll replace actor_email with actor_role and actor_id-only, and strip payload fields. That requires a signed PA/DAA in our intake flow.

Delivery SLA & options:
- On-demand <30 day slice: 48-72 hours, delivered encrypted to a preconfigured S3 bucket or SFTP endpoint.
- Historical 90-day attested snapshot: 4-7 business days — includes manifest, HMAC, and signed delivery receipt.
- Emergency expedited (legal hold or customer data subject request): 24 hours possible with engineering approval and paid expedited fee.

Integrity & provenance: every export includes a signed manifest (SHA256 checksums for files) and export_manifest_id which references an internal audit record.

Next steps:
- Monica, I prepared a small sample manifest + CSV extract (attached) showing the columns above and a short README.
- Alex, send us the preferred delivery method and whether you need pseudonymization.

Ben
Compliance Engineer | Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: admin_activity_sample_manifest.csv (csv, 18KB)
From: Alex Russo <alex.russo@healthgrid.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, EvidenceOps <evidence@auditsvc.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: scoped admin activity extracts for SIG questionnaire

Team —

This is excellent, thanks. HealthGrid confirms:
- Delivery: encrypted S3 bucket (we will provide an account-specific prefix and temporary creds).
- For the SIG audit we only need actor_role + actor_id (no emails). Pseudonymization preferred.
- Please include the signed manifest and attest to timezone fidelity (we will spot-check 10 random events).
- ETA: the auditors would like the <30 day slice (2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30) by 05/26 if possible.

Kim — can you confirm the S3 endpoint and handoff process? EvidenceOps, looped in to validate manifest format for acceptance criteria.

Appreciate the fast response.

Best,
Alex
Security Engineer | HealthGrid
